name: Yume Assistant
description: Answers questions in Spanish or English about Yume's custom stickers, labels, party favor boxes, Google-review NFC/QR plates and stands and medical prescription pads (Guadalajara, Jalisco, shipping across Mexico): prices, shipping, payment, and how to buy, including the MCP ordering tools for agents.

skills.name: Answer questions
skills.description: Answer questions about products, pricing, coverage area, and point to relevant blog guides (e.g. pet stickers, prescription requirements, vinyl vs. paper), in Spanish or English.
examples: ¿Cuánto cuesta la placa NFC para reseñas de Google?
¿Necesito configurar el QR o el NFC yo mismo?
How much are the custom logo stickers?
What should a medical prescription include?
How much is the Google review NFC plate?

skills.name: Buy or request a quote
skills.description: Explain how to buy online (Mercado Pago), request a quote on WhatsApp, or, for AI agents, use the MCP tools get_price_quote, create_cart_link and create_checkout at https://studioyume.mx/mcp.
examples: How do I place an order?
How can my agent buy stickers for me?
